critique.evidence: Strong cyber-defense art direction, restrained cyan/red palette, and clear desktop hierarchy. However, tablet becomes excessively tall, while mobile feels cramped: the headline wraps into five lines, dense proof text is undersized, the red panel stacks awkwardly, and its bottom watermark is visibly clipped. The header also degrades across breakpoints: tablet navigation ends abruptly at “SWIPE,” and mobile drops the brand name and red-mode action while showing only a partial nav rail. Contrast remains unverified for 12 mobile header links and one tablet link.
critique.fix: Polish the responsive composition: reduce mobile headline size or tighten its measure, increase small-text legibility, add breathing room to the stacked evidence cards, and prevent the red panel watermark from clipping. Replace the truncated header rail with an intentional compact navigation pattern that retains branding, current-section context, and the red-mode action; verify link contrast on the actual gradient.
